title: The Idle Golem
text: An iron guardian stands in a ruined square, rusted still in the middle of a stride, one fist raised. Moss grows in its joints. A word is carved on its brow in an old tongue. Change the word, the old stories say, and it might serve a new master.

options.label: The wisest changes the word on its brow, hoping to make it serve a new master.

outcomes.text: It turns, and kneels, and walks with you, a wall of iron at your side.
It turns, and remembers its orders, and you are not on its list.

options.label: The strongest breaks it up for iron, before anyone else gets ideas.

outcomes.text: It is a great deal of iron, and it does not resist, which is worse. It watches the whole time.

options.label: Leave it be. Some guardians are better left at rest.

outcomes.text: Its head turns to watch you go. It was not still at all.
